NewsArticle.Title: Mail & Journal Abroad
NewsArticle.Content:
Mail messengers now deliver Aisling letters from most places in Temuair.
An Aisling may write mail to oneself to keep track of important clues, compose a tale, poetry or treatise.
Mail is easily accessed anywhere: press the second button on the far right, which is just under the blue globe. A slate shall appear. Then press 'Mail.'
View [all features screenshots.](http://www.darkages.com/pics/index_feature.html)
